question:
How many straight lines are there in the star figure? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c6179f12ca294acc27f50f3839f4d1b3a519f9b8a96c16c9739a1ce5f992e0f.png]
solution:
Straight lines are there in the star figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/625aa39fb9565e17ccb90143cc20df1ba8978ebab39a1d7676a5a8b27e46ebe0.png]
